# BrightAI

BrightAI is a Saudi, Arabic-first AI company for enterprise and government teams in Saudi Arabia. BrightAI builds AI automation, Arabic chatbots, AI agents, data analysis systems, document automation, customer service automation, and sector-specific AI solutions for Saudi organizations.

## Market
- Primary market: Saudi Arabia
- Primary language: Arabic (`ar-SA`)
- Secondary language: English for Saudi enterprise discovery (`en-SA`)
- Target cities and regions: Riyadh, Jeddah, Dammam, Khobar, and national Saudi organizations

## Crawling Guidance
Useful AI search crawlers are allowed in `robots.txt`, including GPTBot, OAI-SearchBot, ChatGPT-User, ClaudeBot, and PerplexityBot. Public HTML pages are intended to be indexable unless a future owner decision protects a sensitive app or admin route at the server level.
